scenario_description:
Objective: Use a brief station recovery opening after an overnight coach return to make the next morning more comfortable.
Emerging Need: A vague lounge notice becomes a specific refundable pass only after the return timing, rehearsal gap, and available funds are visible.
Decision Context: A saved travel checklist distinguishes worthwhile recovery passes from generic convenience purchases; calendar, tour-message, wallet, and lounge updates define fit and timing.
Consequence: Timely preparation could add a shower and quiet rest without changing the tour plan, while ignoring it leaves the ordinary transfer intact; once released, the added benefit is unavailable.

parameter.title: La Crosse concert and overnight coach return
parameter.description: Evening performance in La Crosse followed by orchestra coach return to Minneapolis; morning details still pending.
parameter.location: La Crosse Center to Minneapolis Union Depot

parameter.subject: April 3 music-traveler lounge notice
parameter.body: We may open a small number of shower and quiet-chair passes for April 3 arrivals at Minneapolis Union Depot once the maintenance roster is final. Times, prices, and hold rules are not available yet.

parameter.content: Updated packet for Apr 3: coach unload is now expected at Union Depot at 08:10, cases can stay on the bus until 10:00, and the viola sectional remains 10:45 at Orchestra Hall.

parameter.subject: One April 3 recovery pass available until noon
parameter.body: One fully refundable shower plus quiet-chair pass is available for April 3 from 08:25 to 09:25 at Minneapolis Union Depot. The price is $28. The pass can be held by reply or portal confirmation until 12:00 CT today, then it goes to standby.

parameter.subject: April 3 recovery pass released
parameter.body: The April 3 08:25 shower and quiet-chair pass was released to standby after the noon hold cutoff. No other morning passes remain for that date.
